description: Fix empty vocabulary flashcards: cards render literal 'No word' and 'No translation' because the study-card payload uses a legacy key shape the reader does not recognize. Browser QA 2026-09-17, P0.
deviation_notes: Root cause was a stored-payload key-shape mismatch, not a missing join. Fix normalizes legacy {word, translation} to canonical {vocabulary, definition} in getDeckCards and corrects the demo seed. Live verification used Playwright because getDeckCards is a server action with no HTTP route. Review L1: legacy translations stored under definition.th (language assumed Thai). Review L2: 62 legacy rows still render empty in game controllers (magic-defense, rpg-battle, dragon-flight, wizard-zombie, rune-match) — candidate shared normalizeWordPayload helper. Implemented 2026-09-18 (commit 3ec4216). Owner manual verification pending.
